_about: Rides: cars, trucks, bikes, horses and everything else left lying around the county, so nobody has to walk everywhere. Speeds in m/s on a road; offroad is the share of that you keep on grass, dirt and through the woods. seats: [side, along] in metres from the middle (side + is the driver's left). seatH: how high the seat is. keys: the chance one is found with the keys in it; the rest need hotwiring. loud: how far off (m) a running one shows on everyone's minimap. count: how many the county keeps out at once. spawn: where they turn up.

rules._about: lockMs: how long a ride stays yours (crew can still ride) after you get out, before anyone can take it. idleMs: a ride left somewhere with nobody about for this long is towed off (and a fresh one turns up somewhere else). nearSpawn: rides kept within nearRange of every town and landing zone so there's always something to grab.

car.name: Car
car._about: Quick on the blacktop, bogs down off it. Room for four and a small trunk.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup._about: Tough, handles a pasture, two in the cab and two in the bed, big bed for loot.

motorcycle.name: Motorcycle
motorcycle._about: The fastest thing on the road. Loud, and a rider sits in the open.

dirtbike.name: Dirt bike
dirtbike._about: Goes anywhere, through the woods and down the trails. Loud.

atv.name: Four-wheeler
atv._about: Swamp-country workhorse: almost as quick off the road as on it.

golfcart.name: Golf cart
golfcart._about: Slow, quiet, usually has the key in it. Beats walking.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle._about: Silent and nearly twice walking speed. No keys needed.

skateboard.name: Skateboard
skateboard._about: Quick on pavement, useless on grass. Carry nothing, ride standing up.

tractor.name: Tractor
tractor._about: Slow but nothing stops it, and it soaks up a lot of lead.

horse.name: Horse
horse._about: Quiet, goes through the woods and the shallows, turns on a dime. Saddlebags.
